Which federal site helps you report iden: Identity theft is reported to the Federal Trade Commission (FTC).
The FTC’s site builds a personal recovery plan and the forms you need.
Select ALL costs that are part of owning: Total cost of ownership is everything you pay to have and drive the car.
Insurance, fuel, maintenance and registration are all paid on top of the loan.
Which kind of car insurance pays for dam: Ask whose car or property is being paid for: yours or someone else’s.
Damage to others is covered by liability; collision and comprehensive pay for your own car.
Why does a new car usually lose value fa: Depreciation is the loss in a car’s value over time.
The biggest drop comes early, so a new car loses the most value in its first years.
Which factor usually has the biggest eff: A credit score is built from payment history, amounts owed, length of history, new credit and credit mix.
Payment history is the largest part, so on-time payments matter most.
Where can you get free copies of your cr: Federal law gives you free credit reports from Equifax, Experian and TransUnion.
AnnualCreditReport.com is the official site for them; other sites may charge or sell products.
Select ALL items that appear on a credit: A credit report is a record of how you borrow and repay.
Income and savings balances are not borrowing, so they are not on the report.
Your report lists a credit card you neve: An account you never opened may mean someone is using your identity.
Dispute the error with the bureau, then consider a fraud alert or credit freeze.
Checking your own credit report does wha: Checking your own report is a soft inquiry.
Soft inquiries never change your score, so it does nothing.
What does renters insurance usually cove: The landlord owns the building and insures it.
Renters insurance covers what the renter owns and the renter’s liability.
Which charge can a landlord usually dedu: A security deposit can pay for damage beyond normal wear and tear.
A hole punched in a wall is damage; faded paint or small nail holes are normal wear.
Select ALL items to check before signing: A lease is a contract, so you agree to all of its terms when you sign.
Check the length, what is included, the rules and the cost of leaving early.
